description: Answer human review feedback on your own PR end to end: find the latest comments left by real people (bots filtered out), validate each claim against the code, fix the valid ones, resolve merge conflicts with the base, draft replies in the user's voice, then commit, push, post the replies paced, and watch CI until it is green. Use when the user says "address the review", "answer the reviewer's comments", "reply to the reviewers", "handle the new comments on my PR", "/pr-address-review", or asks to fix and respond to what a teammate said on their PR. Works on any GitHub repo with gh auth. Bot comments (Copilot, code-quality) are out of scope; reviewing someone else's PR belongs to pr-review, re-checking it afterwards to pr-verify-review.
